item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.engineering.com/?p=151563","version_id":"90e3adc0a87a45dc20689ae62db7125fe378f8191522f5954fae4ace5e96c803","decision":"accept","reason":"Fresh, highly relevant CAD coverage: an Engineering.com reporter tested Backflip’s new drawing-, photo-, and video-to-CAD modalities rather than merely repeating its announcement. The strongest claim is bounded by a check: after importing downloaded STEP files into Fusion, assigning the specified 1060 aluminum, and comparing mass against two TooTallToby reference exercises, the reporter says both drawing-derived parts matched exactly; that supports geometry/mass agreement on those exercises, not general manufacturability or reliable feature-tree transfer. Evidence is mixed and useful for scrutiny: the Fusion add-in produced incomplete or discrepant geometry, photo-derived geometry and scale were inaccurate, and the system produced only one body for a seven-body shelf; the company CEO’s broader adoption claim remains an attributed commercial prediction. It provides a commercial/startup capability signal for what changed, testable evidence and limitations for claims scrutiny, and practical implications for builders deciding whether STEP-output workflows are ready to evaluate.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
